disabled_in_hub_json: Realtime voice is disabled in manager.json: remove disabled from its entry, then turn it on
key_cleared: The address changed, so the key was cleared. Enter it again
key_needs_url: Enter the service address before the key: the key is only sent to that address
setup_url_and_key: Realtime voice service address and key
warn_default_unknown: manager.json's default is not a model of any upstream, so the first upstream's default model is used
warn_form_id_taken: manager.json already has an upstream with the id custom, so the service in these settings is not used
warn_form_no_key: The service in these settings has no key yet, so it is not used
